insurance.title: Exclusive Insurance Benefits for the RAVU Ecosystem
insurance.text: Despite the essential role riders and drivers play in Tanzania's economy, insurance penetration remains low due to high perceived costs, complicated enrollment and a lack of tailored products. RAVU bridges this gap by giving underwriters a single organized distribution platform.
insurance.discountText: Minimum 20% discount on standard insurance premiums for all verified RAVU members.
insurance.valueAddedIntro: Where constrained by underwriting rules, equivalent value-added benefits include:
insurance.valueAddedText: Reduced deductibles/excess • Complimentary personal accident cover • Emergency roadside assistance • Flexible payment plans • Priority claims processing • Passenger & family extensions • Claim-free loyalty rewards.
insurance.productsText: Spanning individual riders, three-wheelers, member households, SMEs and commercial fleets.
